title: Function splitter: fallthrough false starts and trailing jump tables (all clients)
text: Two analyzer bugs fixed in roc/analyze.py (commit 04e261dda). (1) Starts that reached code falls into with no ret/jmp/call before them were kept as functions: EH catch blocks, catch continuations, 9-byte throw; rethrow chunks (push 0; push 0; call _CxxThrowException, many scored 94% as fake functions), and aligned bytes after an instruction ending in 0xCC (mov ecx,esp = 8B CC, 8B 4D CC, xor ecx,esp = 33 CC) that the int3-padding seed mistook for padding. Now dropped unless a call target, vtable slot, bounds.json or exact. Dropped starts: 2007-03 156, 2007-08 215, 2008-06 130, 2009-06 250, 2010-06 267, 2011-06 304, 2012-06 319. (2) Functions whose switch jump table trails the code were kind bad and never reached the server; now only bytes before the first in-.text data reference must decode (+~180 real code rows per client). No exact changed extent or was lost. Server reseed now resets score to 0 when a row's extent changes (source kept); stored sources for changed rows were resubmitted. 2008-06 also got bounds for 004e3720/00685ea0/00687860/006892d0/00483a00/0065d2c0/007a8380; 00483a00 and 007a8380 now verified exact. Not fixed: about 5 code rows per client start right after a noreturn call (needs proof which callees never return); 2009-12 is a donor so the server never reseeds it.

title: Catch continuations merged; 238 fake catch-funclet exacts found
text: Commit 888f9f2cf: a catch funclet ends mov eax, offset continuation; ret, and MSVC keeps the continuation inside the same __catch$ symbol when it directly follows. Those continuations were separate rows (some listed as code); now merged into the funclet unless called or the funclet has a recorded exact. Server reseeded; 20 resized partials resubmitted; 0065d2c0 _luaV_execute became exact at 4376 bytes. Rejected: a general jump-into-another-row merge rule. MSVC body symbols legitimately jump into their own __catch$ range to reach the shared epilogue (compile of 0040fe50: Create 147 + __catch$ 46 in one section), so that rule broke real exacts. Also rejected: proving exact extents from the previous functions.jsonl (a concurrent session rewrote 2008-06 functions.jsonl at 04:03 using an in-progress analyzer). Open decision: 238 server exacts (2007-08 59, 2008-06 35, 2009-06 30, 2010-06 34, 2011-06 39, 2012-06 41) are 6-byte empty catch funclets (B8 <addr+6> C3) matched by char* f(){return &G;}. They are not real functions; they are protected for now and inflate progress.
